prompt_text: What are the best online courses for learning shadow work and spiritual practice?
ai_overview_text:
Top online courses for learning shadow work and spiritual practice combine depth psychology, somatic tools, and reflective exercises:
Format/Cost: 4 classes (4 hours of video/audio) for $127.
Focus: Explores Carl Jung’s core theory on shadow formation, relationship projections, and recognizing unconscious patterns through symptoms and dreams. Jung Platform
Format/Cost: 2 hours and 5 minutes of video lectures across 16 sections.
Focus: Beginner-friendly inner reflection, heart-chakra self-care, identifying emotional triggers, and integration prompts. Udemy
Format/Cost: Self-paced video course bundled with a 98-page companion workbook for $54.99.
Focus: Sensory exploration of the shadow, generational/ancestral shadow patterns, dream interpretation, and daily forgiveness practices. Udemy
Format/Cost: 10-day audio course (about 10 minutes per day).
Focus: Gentle, beginner-friendly somatic body awareness, inner child healing, and daily integration rituals. Insight Timer
Format/Cost: Self-paced online course with email support from the instructors.
Focus: Bridges Eastern spiritual traditions and shadow integration, emphasizing why balancing light and shadow is vital for true spiritual awakening. Big Shakti
Format/Cost: A variety of self-paced digital programs (ranging from $49 to $134) taught by recognized spiritual teachers and contemplative authors like Tara Brach and Pema Chödrön.
Focus: Merging mindfulness, emotional healing, ego awareness, and subtle energy work into daily conscious living. Sounds True +2
Format/Cost: Free video workshop featuring a guided musical breathwork ceremony.
Focus: Teaches a "victim-and-protector" framework to help interface directly with the subconscious mind and dismantle emotional triggers. YouTube·Aaron Abke
